preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not isinstance(s, str) or not any(c.isdigit() for c in s) else (int(product_str[len(product_str)//2 - 1] + product_str[len(product_str)//2]) if len(product_str) % 2 == 0 else int(product_str[len(product_str)//2]))
postconditions.description: If input is not a string or contains no digits, return -1. Otherwise, compute the product of all digits, convert to string, and return the middle digit (if odd length) or the integer formed by the middle two digits with leading zeros removed (if even length).
